# Security policy

## Reporting a problem

Please report security problems privately through GitHub:
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/daniowensSEO/local-pr-outbound-utm-tagger/security/advisories/new).
Please don't open a public issue or forum topic for them.

Include what you found, the plugin version, and the steps to reproduce it. You'll get a reply as soon as
possible. A fix is released on WordPress.org first, and the report is made public after sites have had time
to update.

## Supported versions

Only the latest version on [WordPress.org](https://wordpress.org/plugins/local-pr-outbound-utm-tagger/)
gets security fixes.
